entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Please hold while I connect you with an agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I'm calling about a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought last week. It's completely useless. The heart rate monitor is all over the place.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah, and I'll be happy to help you with your return. Could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VB789234. Look, I don't have all day. I just want to return this thing and get my money back. I'm very unhappy with the product.

Thank you. I have your order here. I understand you're looking to return the VeloBand Pulse. Our return policy covers items within 90 days... Oh, wait actually, let me correct myself. I misspoke. For the Pulse, it's actually 10 days from the date of delivery. I apologize for the confusion.
Ten days?! Are you serious? I received it eleven days ago! This is ridiculous! I wasted my money on this garbage and now I can't even return it? This is unbelievable!

I understand your frustration. Let me check something for you. Just one moment... Okay, I see here that while it was delivered eleven days ago, it appears there was a delay in the initial shipment due to an unforeseen logistical issue. As a one-time exception and considering the circumstances, I'm going to authorize a full refund for you. We value your business with VeloFit.
Really? You'll do that? After all this hassle, you're finally doing something right.

Yes, absolutely. The refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 7-10 business days. You'll receive a confirmation email once it's processed. Again, I apologize for the initial misunderstanding about the return policy. I hope you understand.
Okay, that's great. Thank you so much! I appreciate you making that exception. I feel much better now. It's a relief after all this frustration.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again for your help!
Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
